info.title: Phone & Accessory Shop API
info.description: Backend for a small retail shop: phones, accessories, sales, debts, expenses and statistics. Multi-tenant — all data scoped by shop.

inviteCode.description: Required only when the server sets INVITE_CODE

refreshToken.description: The raw refresh token issued at login/refresh

name.description: Do'kon nomi — printed on the label

labelFooter.description: Footer text printed at the bottom of the label

imei.description: Optional. No length limit (supports dual-IMEI entries).

supplierName.description: Supplier's first name — who the shop bought the phone from.

supplierPhone.description: Supplier phone number for follow-up contact.

purchasePrice.description: What the shop paid (UZS). 0 allowed (free intake).

usedGrade.description: Wear grade. Only allowed when condition is USED.

hasBox.description: Whether the phone has its original box. Independent of condition.

hasCharger.description: Whether the phone comes with its charger. Independent of condition and box.

saleId.description: The sale this debt belongs to

originalAmount.description: Original debt amount at sale time

supplierName.description: Supplier's first name — who the shop bought the phone from.

supplierPhone.description: Supplier phone number for follow-up contact.

salePrice.description: Actual sold price (sotilgan narx) for a SOLD phone, from its sale; null while IN_STOCK

profit.description: salePrice - purchasePrice for a SOLD phone; null otherwise

usedGrade.description: Wear grade; only set when condition is USED, else null.

hasBox.description: Whether the phone has its original box (null = unknown).

hasCharger.description: Whether the phone comes with its charger (null = unknown).

debt.description: Debt info when the phone was sold on debt; null otherwise. Shows original amount, remaining balance and the payment history.

imei.description: Optional. No length limit (supports dual-IMEI entries).

supplierName.description: Supplier's first name — who the shop bought the phone from.

supplierPhone.description: Supplier phone number for follow-up contact.

purchasePrice.description: What the shop paid (UZS). 0 allowed (free intake).

usedGrade.description: Wear grade. Only allowed when condition is USED.

hasBox.description: Whether the phone has its original box. Independent of condition.

hasCharger.description: Whether the phone comes with its charger. Independent of condition and box.

memory.description: Omitted when both ram and storage are null

costPrice.description: Cost snapshot for these units (olingan narx)

quantity.description: Units sold at this price, net of returns

purchasePrice.description: Cost of this intake. 0 allowed (free intake).

remainingQuantity.description: Units from this batch still on hand (FIFO)

remaining.description: Units from this intake still on hand (FIFO)

salePrice.description: The accessory's current default sale price

newAccessory.description: Create a new accessory for this line instead

purchasePrice.description: Unit cost of this intake. 0 allowed (free intake).

salePrice.description: Default sale price to set on the accessory. Updates the accessory's current salePrice (works for both existing and new accessories). Omit to leave it unchanged.

customerName.description: Buyer name captured at sale time (optional).

customerPhone.description: Buyer phone captured at sale time (optional).

profit.description: Profit net of returns: sum (unitPrice - costPrice) * (qty - returnedQty)

stockEntryId.description: Required when type = ACCESSORY — the stock batch (prixod layer) to sell from

quantity.description: Units to sell (ACCESSORY only; phones are always 1)

customerName.description: Optional buyer name for follow-up (not required).

customerPhone.description: Optional buyer phone for follow-up (not required).

debt.description: Restated debt. `amount` is the balance the customer STILL owes (outstanding). Already-collected installments and refunds are preserved. Omit or send null when nothing is owed (fully-cash / fully-settled). Editing works even with returns or prior repayments; the new total just cannot fall below cash already collected.

amount.description: Refund amount. Defaults to the proportional sold amount; may be lower, never higher.

productName.description: Comma-joined product names on the sale

saleTotalAmount.description: Total amount of the underlying sale

paidAmount.description: Amount already paid on the sale

paidTotal.description: Sum of all payments made against this debt

amount.description: Payment amount. May be a partial payment; cannot exceed the remaining balance.

paidAt.description: Payment date; defaults to today (shop-local). May be back-dated.

grossProfit.description: phone profit + accessory profit, net of returns

cashIn.description: sale paidAmount + debts settled within range
